notes.title: Patch 1.2.18890
notes.notes:
[h2]SHODAN continues to perfect![/h2]
[h3]Fixed:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Full-auto modkit now allow the AR to fire individual shots as fast as it should have.
[*] A case where an empty hotbar slot could be highlighted as if it was equipped has been fixed.
[*] The Hacker's gender no longer resets to male when loading a game. This is in order to handle 1.1 saves properly due to the field not being serialized. Bug only occurs when swapping between 1.2 female and 1.1 male saves.

[/list]

Thanks again to all insects who throw themselves at the alter of Shodan. Your support and helps us reach the vision we've always had for this classic game. Enjoy your improved experience within the warrens of Citadel Station.

- Your System Shock Team

notes.title: Patch 1.2.18887
notes.notes:
[h2]Behold![/h2]
[h3]Fixed:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fix for 1.1 saves not loading properly on maps with a Loader Bot present.
[*]Fix a case where after loading a save the player would remain in a combat state indefinitely.
[*]Fix several cases where mission waypoints were showing up incorrectly.
[*]Fix for user waypoints not showing up on the map.
[*]Fix for Shodan not animating in the final pseudospace sequence.
[*]Fix for several effects not rendering properly on the female hacker.
[*]Fix vertical spacing issues on subtitle text on certain display configs.
[*]Fix for movement inputs sticking when entering and exiting menus.
[*]Fix for not being able to throw grenades when jumping.
[*]Fix for corpses and limbs being frustum culled while still on the screen.
[*]Fix for computer node monitors on Storage not displaying the correct code in certain cases.
[*]Fix Reactor region labels on the automap.
[*]Fix for cargo lift screen not displaying level transition properly in some cases.
[*]Fix for cyberspace FOV interfering with realspace FOV in certain cases.
[*]Fix for Diego remaining invisible if staggered while teleporting.
[*]Fix for coins sometimes being invisible when dispensed from Credit Machines.
[/list]
[h3]Adjusted:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Shotgun reloading will now prioritize small ammo stacks.
[*]'Vaporize All' will ignore existing scrap items.
[*]Reduced Avian Mutant health from 125 to 100.
[*]Force Diego V3 to reappear when he dies to prevent cases where his corpse would be invisible.
[*]Hacking a robot will reduce their awareness by 90% instead of only 50%, but the effect wears off instantly if they are damaged.
[*]Hooked up cooldown and disabled states for cyberspace software.
[*]Made Decoy and Recall software obey stacking mechanics and consume only one per use.
[/list]
[h3]Added:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added the ability to create messages for user waypoints.
[*]Added a health bar for the player in the final pseudospace sequence.
[*]Added shortcuts to use Explosives and Consumables on the RB/LB buttons on the gamepad.
[/list]
In case you missed the latest update, read about it here:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/482400/view/4185606994277120701

Thanks again for the players support and helping us reach the vision we've always had for this classic game. We look forward to seeing you insects once more in Citadel Station.
- Your System Shock Team

notes.title: September 2021 Update
notes.notes:
News

It’s been a wild couple of months as we continue to work towards launching the game we’ve all been patiently waiting for. I know there has been some confusion over dates, and announcements which is an unfortunate reality of making games, but I can assure you that System Shock is on the way. We have some big news to share in the future that will help make sense of what’s been going on, and again we thank you for your patience.

[i]What are we working on?[/i]

We are working on the final polish for the enemies, weapons, levels, and cinematics. We will post a few screenshots here, but we’re at the point where we don’t want to ruin any surprises.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25480336/87be3678da0c283a3b661ec040661f049d8db08d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25480336/a5267e314a42ad5fd34bcf5614d3dc83c937692d.png[/img][/url]

System Engineering - Early Blockout

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25480336/7ea15d2c25034b61eab61697b94e9b087af870ad.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25480336/eaaf28ad947aaf1fcaad2c951da49adbc8bf2366.png[/img][/url]

We will have a few updates coming to the demo which include full dismemberment across all enemies along with updated AI, new behaviors, new animations and hit reactions, updated weapon fx as well as numerous bug fixes and performance optimizations. We’ve compiled feedback from discord and the various forums and will continue to do so to improve the game. A big thanks to everyone who has been sharing their feedback with us in a constructive way, it’s greatly appreciated and extremely helpful!

notes.title: February Kickstarter Update
notes.notes:
[b]Welcome back Hackers![/b]

We’ve got a very special update this month - as you are aware we’re releasing our final demo and opening pre-orders on Steam, GOG, and the Epic Games Store which should be available as you read this. This is a major milestone in our development of System Shock and once again we’d like to thank you for your continued patience and support while we diligently create the experience you originally backed all those years ago.

Our development road was bumpy (to say the least) - but ultimately what you’re playing is the vision and experience we set out to create and the adversity and challenges we’ve faced along the way has only improved the final game. The team has evolved and grown considerably and we hope that the end product will meet your expectations. With all that said we are planning on a late Summer 2021 release date.

[i]On to the demo - Let’s run through all the updates![/i]

[b]NEW [/b]Cyberspace Level! (tame those cyber doggies!)

[b]NEW [/b]Crew Audio Logs! (no devs this time!)

[b]NEW[/b] SHODAN Audio! (Terri is back!)

[b]NEW [/b]Dismemberment! (if Viva Pinata were rated M!)

[b]NEW [/b]Proximity Mines! (don’t get too close!)

[b]NEW [/b]Bugs! (tell us what you find :D)

[b]NEW[/b] Enemies! (the repair bot is flamin’ hot!)

[b]NEW[/b] GenerativeMusic System! (never the same song twice!)

[b]NEW[/b] Snack! (make your selection at the Snacktron!)

[b]NEW [/b]Save Feature! (what a novelty!)

[b]NEW[/b] Notes System! (USB 1.1 support!)

[b]NEW [/b]Difficulty Modes! (crank it all the way up to 3!)

[b]NEW [/b]Destructibility! (smash that glass!)

[b]NEW[/b] DLSS Support! (update your drivers for your RTX card!)

[b]NEW [/b]Trailer! (a ton of new reveals!)

[b]NEW[/b] Nightdive intro! (who’s that lurking in the depths?)

[b]NEW [/b]Secrets! (first to post a picture of the special skull to our Twitter wins a prize!)


So check it out and please tell us what you think - we value your feedback and look forward to hearing from you.


[i]-Stephen[/i]

notes.title: February Kickstarter Update
notes.notes:
[b]♡✧An update full of love✧♡[/b]

Well, these barrels aren't full of love, they will kill you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25480336/4bf7aa0a3d233e18afd786be25f496dffc675913.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25480336/5cafd85fdc049bb2b44170efd40cf9a97169dc07.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25480336/40a3bae94edc67bcc5bac427b4ddc6dfb2dcb050.png[/img]

[b]Concept Art[/b]

The topic of concept art is buzzing a lot in the comment section, so let us explain. Yes, concept art is often a big part of the early stages of development, however, concept art is something constantly being created. Concept art can help sort out design, establish a mood, assist modelers with functionality as well as perspective. Needless to say, it is pretty important and we are very lucky to have Robb Waters on the team!

Here are a few things that help build the environment of Citadel Station.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25480336/eda4b3fb66446cef7f652077dab480245cc0937b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25480336/015f467c7a74f44f3db4318d556b1619666ab43e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25480336/83c6c0d47c71cf65fe0b45cbcf7256c11c644eaa.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25480336/2c6b573b8f108436a2096f5cc3ef122543616747.jpg[/img]

[b]Character Proxy Models[/b]

Proxies are autogenerated topology created from near-finished hi-poly models. Though rough and untextured, proxies represent the overall shape of the character well enough so that they can be handed off to our rigging and animation team; that way they don’t have to wait for the time-consuming low-poly, UV, and texture phases before they can get started. Proxies are also useful in that they can be seen in motion and potential issues with proportion or clipping can be looked for and adjusted in the hi-poly model before a character’s look is fully nailed down. Once the modeler is finished with the final textured models, the skeletal rigging of the proxy can be copied over, essentially swapping the proxy mesh out with the final.

Below are some animations made using proxy models of our more bizarre characters: the Cyber Mantis, a Cyber Assassin with the bladed arms of an Autosurgeon grafted on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25480336/9bec7f28ae4d8143e2c05daeecf750480442a7af.jpg[/img]

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1598858095/system-shock/posts/2750421]Read the full update to see the animation videos![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25480336/08e37e2fe46af8dff1c1d4c7dff6808c885ad3cb.gif[/img]

Then there is the bizarre Plant Mutant species that infests the Groves.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25480336/9946bf2ef5c9ca45ab19fc1408ccc289572e8d7e.jpg[/img]

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1598858095/system-shock/posts/2750421]Read the full update to see the animation videos![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25480336/c93dd81623404b8adfae083d0ec647a5c28fb313.gif[/img]

[b]Proxies[/b]

Here are two more proxies just about to be handed off to the rigging and animation team, the Execbot and the Gorilla-Tiger. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25480336/cb96f1e69517c45a63d6026206bdb460d2e30214.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25480336/fde579206ea2e129249cb3bc2d52dcf79efa7cef.png[/img]

notes.title: September Kickstarter Update
notes.notes:
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1598858095/system-shock/posts/2615923][u][b]Welcome to this September Update![/b][/u][/url]

We will be going through some of the environments, art direction and how characters come together. Everyone has been working so hard, so please enjoy!

[u][b]Environments[/b][/u]
This month we have a variety of storage based environment pieces to show, starting with an in engine view of the cold storage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25480336/817f42973d2c1f1e815009ff68db252e5c4c6231.gif[/img]
 
Robb's concepts of containers and storage that are soon to come. Wait... what's that gorilla tiger doing up there?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25480336/9408cfb51979b6e9ae028bb394a230ec5ed35c50.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25480336/dfa533d4c89ace36bbfa98d7eb49871285fd8998.png[/img]
 
 
[u][b]System Shock’s Texture Aesthetic[/b][/u]

Here’s a look into the approach we’re taking with textures of the game. With System Shock we want to create a quasi retro look that combines modern physically based rendering tech with a low-res, pixelated texture aesthetic that evokes the low resolution of the original game. To this end, the texel density of every object and character in the game is strictly limited to only 256 pixels per meter, to keep the level of pixelization consistent across all surfaces. Like some modern 2d games that combine old school aesthetics with modern framerates and effects, we hope to use some of the limitations of old graphical styles to give a unique feeling, evocative of how you might remember older games rather than how they actually looked. 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25480336/f40553c6c61ca12273ef3d8a542ed854f8d3f1a5.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25480336/d5fa5a21500fd2fff69933e77cf0bd57bcc7bd8e.jpg[/img]
 
A consequence of this low-res aesthetic is that UV need to be very meticulously laid out to keep details as clean and readable as possible while also minimizing ugly distortions that would be less noticeable at higher resolutions.  UV edges need to be “squared off” when possible and lined up exactly along texel edges to try to ensure a clean, readable texture pattern. Literally every pixel counts, and from a character artist’s perspective this is possibly the most challenging aspect of production.

As an example, here’s the low-poly model of our new version of the male Humanoid Mutant on the right, next to his older prototype on the left Though very similar, we bulked him up slightly and humanized his face to make him appear a more mutant and less zombie.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25480336/3f30d6eb6b02978873bf69720b1beaffffca167d.jpg[/img]
 
A major change however is in their UVs - the original layout was made before we adopted this texturing style, and while this layout works fine at modern texture resolutions, it introduces warping and unnecessary seams at our low texel density. The new version’s UVs attempt to minimize seams and conform as much as possible to the texture grid.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25480336/ca48116caff08ccff58a0ff1931670067301cb6c.jpg[/img]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25480336/2b6587c751d9b9c810d08d00583127c6e97b0ee3.jpg[/img]
 
Here’s some different angles of the Mutant low-poly model along with a couple wireframes:
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25480336/ab29937143462f199f2f22fe91218c82504e5dbb.jpg[/img]
 
And here’s some shots of him taken from Substance Painter. 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25480336/20322ad534fbe92a8976de7ff85094bb5f1b215c.jpg[/img]
 
Next month we’ll be able to showcase several more fully textured characters, but in the meantime here are some more low-poly models with their wireframes.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25480336/1b1c343f65a9d837d32d1183d1824082be02bc80.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25480336/b9ac6fa8dadb8cf50d18d2f787995f3de04f6b3c.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25480336/b47ae63248da387e24cb2cee96f8c820c8bbd470.jpg[/img]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25480336/547d9893314f18d0d5ff7498a71365b1e6f32274.jpg[/img]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25480336/7b3eeae5e0d83cd11e5c5c0bd14ef2072b96ff35.jpg[/img] 
 
[u][b]The Shockbot[/b][/u]
On to hi-poly model progress, here’s Robb Waters’s extensive concepts and Chris Mansell’s detailed model for the Shockbot, arguably the most critical character model in the game.  
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25480336/553042af931f3a73481a879aa7e854eb9ed6a9a0.jpg[/img]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25480336/59cfaba35a1e0b5fa82eb464884d5cb408b1b592.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25480336/1fda204ba165d388108c7f43e00a63416c065701.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25480336/cbb1899e9b9dd9a5e32fe12d9ee30f2f33591c39.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25480336/ad20f57d8a3a1341a439312964c9ad8d557abca3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25480336/fd7d240a85aa1da16101b9af4522a4c377984c65.png[/img]
 
Why is he so important?  Since SHODAN is forced to repurpose existing technology aboard Citadel Station, the Shockbot is the foundation for a number of her minions.  The Cyborg Elite and Cyborg Enforcer are composed largely of repurposed Shockbot parts, and the Flier-Bot is in fact the Shock-bot’s detachable, transforming torso unit!  The Cyborg Warrior has been reconceptualized as an enhanced Shockbot with a human brain grotesquely grafted in place.   Here’s a look at the Shockbot and Laborbot’s grim family tree.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25480336/dc90b806da2f49528c9df20bb07f6826fbc7138c.jpg[/img]
 
Speaking of the Warrior, here’s Robb’s ortho design for the head and the enhanced laser weapon it will wield.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25480336/3af14c12c1bf1172dd14c02b0e1627c151e091e2.jpg[/img]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25480336/56d0a55fa2c97367978bf079d07ab296038de075.jpg[/img]

And here are some very early WIP renders of the hi-poly Warrior skull 
and cable support system mounted onto a Shockbot body.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25480336/b35ea940ab0dc74446a66dfd496ff6e3ab7497f8.jpg[/img]

[u][b] 
Puzzles[/b][/u]
While on Citadel, you may run in to a few obstacles beyond an enemy attack. For example, a wire puzzle:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25480336/f23a8e4418eb65bc4fcd8b4a3ae9c7f2d50650fc.gif[/img]
 
We will leave you on a final concept for the month, Edward Diego.

notes.title: August Kickstarter Update
notes.notes:
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1598858095/system-shock/posts/2586033][b]Are you ready for this months update?[/b][/url]

I am thinking that we should start off this update with a bathroom break.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25480336/bdc94c08a0bbd166c2973369efef10e6228c554a.png[/img]

[u][b]Level Design[/b][/u]

Last month we showed a concept from the maintenance level, and now here it is coming together. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25480336/65f15eb723798d6fff9ff34b9a6dfd013c6a1488.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25480336/0fa80a0bbde0c0d39ed408ebb127a4bf96e80376.png[/img]

Here is another concept from Robb Waters of the maintenance level. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25480336/f657408f18587259c356f0da1a8c6f2e984a3a18.jpg[/img]

Moving along to some things in progress...

[u][b]Character Design[/b][/u]

Here are some concept and work in progress models for the Protoborgs, yet-unprocessed Citadel crew members awaiting full cyberconversion. Whether a thrall of Shodan or a minion of Trioptimum, all cybernetic humans are marked by bio-mechanical circuitry running within the connective fascia tissue beneath their skin. Male and female protoborgs can be found in coma-like stasis around the Medical level, and their bodies are also the organic base for cyborg enemies such as the Drone, Enforcer, Elite and Assassin.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25480336/0007b21515ebae5afc78bee4ffa90079b905ac84.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25480336/02ba378f2916e9d4d8aebb6c87a1fea9a9c1cf12.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25480336/406d765901a407d66abbaf2877a75fd0fd192d88.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25480336/a8ebb903ab9911582e46e6f033bc2205940f398a.jpg[/img]

An update to the hood for the Cyborg Assassin. Robb decided that tucking the visor under the hood made its presence too subtle, so we’ve opted to install it over the hood to better evoke the iconic look of the original.

Then Robb's [i]sleek[/i] redesign of the Autobomb. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25480336/be018c158e5bb2c5306274bac5df4da86f0f0c37.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25480336/f0434c444cfdb6aeaf5f9ffe9261a5d93b2aeaa2.jpg[/img]

[u][b]Environment Props [/b][/u]

Last month you may have noticed the proxy table in the operating theater, here it is complete! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25480336/db6717eea930bd9500360e69008e98598aab7215.png[/img]

Can you imagine the meetings that must have happened at this TriOp executive table?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25480336/09ea080413fd792f70b566c33a9694379114214a.png[/img]

[u][b]GamePig[/b][/u]

VMU is not liable for any accidents which may occur due to distraction from playing GamePigTM games in a heads-up display. Oink!

Robb Waters has really outdone himself in this awesome Space Minotaur poster.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25480336/50d82041c55084a0546f254bc10d139fee4b0129.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25480336/2ec4a94377c612931fae981ad2175f3cf323d3ae.gif[/img]

Our programmer Matt K. has been hard at work to bring back the GamePig to Citadel Station, [i]we hope you don't get too distracted![/i]
